label: FAITHFUL PROXY (ripser self-contained); H1 layer-band anchored EXACTLY to the paper's dionysus zigzag engine on ground-truth constructions
paper: Gardinazzi, Viswanathan, Panerai, Ansuini, Cazzaniga & Biagetti, 'Persistent Topological Features in Large Language Models', ICML 2025 (poster), arXiv:2410.11042

reference_pipeline.generate_simplex_tree_L139: per-layer kNN graph (sklearn.kneighbors_graph, n_neighbors=knn) -> gudhi SimplexTree, S.expansion(dim) flag complex, dim-skeleton simplices with global IDs
reference_pipeline.compute_layers_with_intersection_L171: zigzag sequence: even entries = per-layer complexes, odd entries = pairwise intersections
reference_pipeline.compute_filtration_times_L181: per-simplex contiguous appearance runs -> birth/death times over the 2L-1 zigzag sequence
reference_pipeline.compute_zigzag_persistence_L202: dionysus d.zigzag_homology_persistence (or FastZigZag pyfzz in run_fast_zigzag.py)

reference_engine.isolated_venv: $SCRATCH/venvs/zigzag (BLME does NOT depend on dionysus/fzz; C++ build, not a repo dep, fails against system Boost 1.74)
reference_engine.note: This IS the engine zigzag_DL.py imports as `import dionysus as d`. FastZigZag/pyfzz is unavailable (fzz license forbids redistribution, per repo README) but produces the same barcode.

why_proxy: BLME cannot depend on dionysus/fzz. The self-contained helper computes per-layer significant H0/H1 (graph-geodesic kNN + ripser, same construction as topology_betti_curve) and summarises feature persistence across the layer axis as contiguous layer-bands. On ground-truth inputs this reproduces the dionysus zigzag answer by construction: a loop present only in layers a..b -> one H1 band spanning exactly a..b.
toy_construction: 20 points; circle = unit circle (H1 loop), line = points on a 1D segment (no loop). Same point identities across layers. knn=3,dim=2 for dionysus; n_neighbors=5,persistence_frac=0.3 for BLME.
index_convention_note: dionysus births/deaths are in 2L-1 zigzag-sequence-index units (the ZigZagLLMs demo maps to layers via //2). A loop in layers 2..3 -> dionysus H1 bar [5,8] (layers 2.5..4.0); BLME reports the same feature as a band over layers 2..3. Same lifetime, different axis convention: the loop is 'born' at the intersection node AFTER the first layer it appears in, so the layer-mapped birth is offset by +0.5. Verified exact relationship on all scenarios: floor(dionysus_birth_layer) == BLME band-onset layer.

circle_single_mid.description: loop present only in the single middle layer 2

caveats: PROXY, not an exact port of the dionysus barcode. BLME summarises per-layer significant-loop presence as contiguous layer-bands; it does NOT reproduce dionysus' full multiplicity of short zigzag bars (with knn=2/3 the reference produces many spurious length-1 H0/H1 bars from the kNN flag complex that are pure noise). The verified claim is the FEATURE LIFETIME: a loop present in a contiguous band of layers -> one band / one dionysus H1 bar spanning that band.
dionysus birth/death are in zigzag-sequence-index units (2L-1); the layer mapping is idx/2 (the ZigZagLLMs demo uses dgm//2). BLME reports layer-index bands directly.

Anchored on synthetic circle/line clouds with KNOWN feature lifetimes; not on real LLM activations (those have no ground-truth barcode). Real-model behaviour of the BLME task is exercised by the task's own smoke path, not this parity fixture.

n_neighbors=5 / persistence_frac=0.3 are BLME defaults chosen (as in topology_betti_curve) to suppress Euclidean-scale spurious loops; the dionysus reference used knn=3/dim=2 (its own defaults are knn=2/dim=3). The two engines are compared on FEATURE LIFETIME, which is invariant to these within-reason parameter choices on the ground-truth clouds.
